reason: The cited evidence (all from the same paper) shows ZrC acts as a second phase and improves room-temperature hardness and corrosion resistance, but provides no data on high-temperature microstructural stability, oxidation kinetics, creep resistance, or thermal cycling lifetime. The key premises about high-temperature mechanisms and durability are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
